name: qa_sample_load
title: OS-SAMPFMT, rows QA-SLD-002..006, and OS-LOADCH, rows QA-SLD-011..014, of docs/qa/catalogue/sample_load.md: Sample load lists and loads an AIFF and an IFF 8SVX from the maintainer's test folders at the card root (/AIFF, /8SVX, ...; PC copy build-sdtest//, see its SOURCES.txt; git-ignored, never committed): /AIFF/afsp_16bit_stereo.aif and /8SVX/kc_luvhorn_8363_loop.8svx (a real Amiga sample, 8363 Hz, with a repeat part), then /8SVX/gen-fib-8363.8svx (Fibonacci-delta) and two files that must be refused: /AIFF/t_aifc_fl32.aifc (float) and /AIFF/gen-bad-truncssnd.aif (truncated SSND).

steps.say: OS-SAMPFMT. The card holds the maintainer's test folders at its root (/AIFF, /8SVX). The first load is a 16-bit stereo AIFF (mixed (L+R)/2), the second an 8SVX at its own rate (the rate is kept, nothing is resampled, and the Modern engine plays it at the pitch of that rate (OS-RATEPITCH; qa_ratepitch.json measures it)). The audible rows are by ear: the 8SVX should sound at its Amiga pitch.

steps.note: (instrument 2 is the load target: a pad on the Instrument screen picks it)
RESCAN

steps.say: Move the cursor to the folder AIFF at the card root (F3 enters a folder), then to afsp_16bit_stereo.aif: QA-SLD-002, the list shows .aif / .aifc files (and, in /8SVX, .8svx) beside .wav

steps.note: QA-SLD-002: both files are listed (the simulator's picture of such a list is gallery/sampleload_formats)
QA-SLD-003: F1 LOAD of /AIFF/afsp_16bit_stereo.aif
the strip says PEAKS AFSP_16BIT_STEREO.AIF DONE; the instrument is named afsp_16bit_stereo, RATE the file's (no pitch warning any more), the wave of the file

steps.say: Choose instrument 3 with a pad, go to /8SVX and move the cursor to kc_luvhorn_8363_loop.8svx

steps.note: QA-SLD-004: F1 LOAD of /8SVX/kc_luvhorn_8363_loop.8svx
the rate of the file is kept (the old PITCH IS OFF warning is gone, OS-RATEPITCH)
the instrument is named by the file's NAME chunk (or kc_luvhorn_8363_loop), RATE 8363 Hz, the repeat part as the loop (play mode LOOP FWD)
QA-SLD-005: a pad plays the 8SVX instrument (by ear: at its Amiga pitch, looping while held when it has a repeat part)

steps.say: Choose instrument 4, load /8SVX/gen-fib-8363.8svx (Fibonacci-delta, one-shot, 8363 Hz): it loads like the plain one (RATE 8363 Hz, no loop)

steps.note: QA-SLD-006: the Fibonacci-delta 8SVX loads

steps.say: Choose instrument 5, go to /AIFF and load t_aifc_fl32.aifc (float, refused), then gen-bad-truncssnd.aif (truncated SSND, refused): each says IMPORT <NAME> FAILED in the strip and changes nothing

steps.note: the float AIFF-C is refused

steps.say: OS-LOADCH. A stereo file can be loaded as its LEFT or its RIGHT channel. Go to /AIFF, cursor on afsp_16bit_stereo.aif: the list shows ST at its right, and F8 (bottom right) reads CH MIX. On a mono file (t_16bit_mono.aif) F8 reads -- and says ONLY FOR A STEREO FILE. Choose instrument 6 with a pad.

steps.note: QA-SLD-011: ST at the right of afsp_16bit_stereo.aif, F8 CH MIX
QA-SLD-012: F8 -> LEFT
QA-SLD-012: F1 LOAD the left channel
QA-SLD-012: the wave of the LEFT channel alone: peaks near 14,000 of 32,768 (about 44 percent of the lane)

steps.say: Choose instrument 7 with a pad. F8 once more is RIGHT (CH RIGHT), then F1 loads the right channel of the same file.

steps.note: QA-SLD-013: F8 -> RIGHT
QA-SLD-013: F1 LOAD the right channel
QA-SLD-013: the wave of the RIGHT channel alone: peaks near 6,400 (about 20 percent of the lane), a different picture from LEFT; both are mono samples (the same length, one lane)

steps.say: The choice stays while the unit is on: leave Sample load and come back, F8 still reads CH RIGHT. Press F8 once more for CH MIX. Then choose instrument 8, go to /AIFF and load t_ssnd_before_comm.aif (SSND before COMM, a known limit).

steps.note: QA-SLD-014: SSND before COMM
the strip says AIFF: SSND BEFORE COMM NOT SUPPORTED, not DAMAGED FILE; instrument 8 is unchanged
QA-SLD-014: the strip's words
